product_title: F&H Men's Jurassic World Chris Pratt Owen Grady Genuine Leather Vest
review_body:
So I got my Grady vest in the mail from a company I found on amazon.com called Flesh & Hide. They make a lot of replica jackets and I decided to pull the trigger and buy the Grady Vest. I wanted to post some pics of it and my initial thoughts.
Firstly, I know it's not screen accurate and that is fine with me. It's pretty darn close so if total accuracy isn't a problem then it's more than acceptable. The big differences I see are the lack of a cinch-belt on the back, pocket layout on the lower left and the zipper goes a little higher up on the chest than his.
It's made of lambskin leather with a satin liner. The materials seem pretty high quality to me and the stitching looks strong.
I wear a medium to large shirt and a 38/40 jacket so I purchased the medium as I didn't want it to be too baggy and it fits perfect. For reference I'm about 5'8" tall and 175lbs. My wife was pretty impressed and she's not easy to sell on most of my prop/costume purchases.
I'm probably going to hit it with some rubbing alcohol to knock down the shine and weather it a bit using water, saddle soap and a conditioner. It's pretty light (but not in a cheap way) and the material is nice and supple so there isn't a ton of breaking in to do. I've never weathered leather before and I don't want to screw it up so I'll probably do it in small bits.
I know the original designer is making them for $750 a pop but that's way out of my price range. This one came in at around $160 before shipping which is much more reasonable. So, if 100% accuracy isn't a big deal and you don't have a ton to drop on it then I highly suggest this option. I'm def sold on Flesh & Hide products now and will probably look at some of their other replicas. I also plan on wearing this on a daily basis (not just for a costume) so I'll update down the road as I put some hours of wear on it. Mostly hiking around the woods studying birds and doing soil tests.

product_title: Ekouaer Women's Strapless Convertible Padded Underwire T Shirt Bra 32B-42DDD
review_body:
This review is for the balconette style bra.

Having some experience with Ekouaer products, I got this in one band size larger than my usual (i.e., 36B instead of 34B). That was definitely the right choice. So my first piece of advice is to size up one band size from what you would normally wear. (Cup size, on the other hand, was fine.)

There is a lot of room to adjust the shoulder straps but whatever position they're in, they stay in place. They didn't slide down my shoulders at all and I've had them on all day.

The band is pretty thick (has two hooks arranged one above the other) and the bra provides a lot of support. I wouldn't wear it for working out, but it's certainly more than adequate for daily wear. The fabric seems to be of high quality and I did not notice any loose threads. This does have an underwire but I found that fairly comfortable (as underwires go).

This is a cute but pretty standard (for daily wear) bra. Although the straps can be worn several different ways, I tend to default to a basic configuration because that works with most of my shirts. (It's easy to undo the hooks to change the configuration, though, and they stay in place once arranged.)

Overall, a high quality bra at a competitive price. Wish it was also offered in some other colors!

Product provided by the seller for evaluation purposes.

product_title: CharmLeaks Women's Crochet One-piece Swimsuit
review_headline: Gorgeous suit, beautiful materials, but order WAY up!
review_body:
I should tell you that the teenager I got this for normally wears a medium (10 or 12) but we decided on the large in this because we figured it would run small. When it arrived, she wasn't able to use it for two reasons. The bra is REALLY, REALLY small and she prefers modest suits. If you want to "show some skin" you'll be fine. Also, the band around the top of the mesh part (below the bra) is stretchy, but not real stretchy. She has a rather athletic build and it was too tight for her.

So we offered it to a teen relative who is very slim and small breasted and she loves it. It isn't immodest on her because she doesn't have much to cover up.

I was a little afraid that it would be cheap and sleezy looking, but it has the look of an expensive suit. The bikini bottom is well-lined. I wouldn't call it modestly cut, but it's not too outrageous. The mesh part is very dark brown and is a beautiful design. There's a golden heart-shaped ornament on the bottom and the stretchy straps are attached to the bra cups with very attractive gold fastenings. The bra cups are well-lined. They just aren't very big. I was impressed that it comes with a removable paper liner in the crotch (some internet suits DON'T) and that the tag can be removed without tearing the delicate fabric. Care and thought went into the design and marketing of this product and I appreciate that.

I was given a free sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. It's a lovely suit and looks expensive and well-made. If you can get the right size or if you like to strut your stuff, you'll probably like it.

product_title: Miusol Women's Casual Deep- V Neck Sleeveless Vintage Wedding Maxi Dress
review_headline: Yay! Done dress shopping!!! I FOUND IT!!
review_body: I don't often spend over $50 on a dress, but I needed something a little dressier for my daughter's wedding. I didn't have time to shop, so I took a risk and bought it here. First, the good: The dress has a lace top. Lace has a tendency to be stiff and scratchy. This lace is soft and feels good. The dress is made of a somewhat stretchy material, so even the odd bod will have a good fit. The waist is higher, sitting just below the bust line. This means those who have given birth and bear a bit of midriff excess as a reminder will hide it nicely. I am 5'6 and weight 144...measurements are 38x32x39. I normally wear a size 6 to 8. I ordered a large and it fit me beautifully with room for that piece of wedding cake. My daughter who is 5'7 weighing 122 who normally wears a 2-4 wanted to try it on because she thought it was so beautiful. She said despite the fact that the dress was a tiny bit loose on her, it still looked great. The dress just graces the floor from my shoulders, so shoes will keep it off the ground. The zipper zips easily. All the seams are sewn well. Second, the bad: None. Nope. No bad stuff here. It's five stars all the way! UPDATE: 9/9/2015...I wore this dress for my daughter's wedding, on which occasion 4.13" of rain fell in torrents. We held the wedding on our island, and following my saturated guests' leads, I jumped off the bridge and SWAM IN THIS DRESS! 1. The dress was STILL comfortable and STILL held up well despite my lunacy. 2. The dress came clean and looks as good as new.  After my swimming expedition, I still received compliments on how pretty the dress looked!!! I wore a dark blue bra with the dark blue dress, and it looked just fine. I wore 1" heels with it, and I did find I had to pick up the hem as it dragged a couple inches. If I were a seamstress or had a little more time, I might have hemmed it up a bit. I am sorely tempted to cut it to tea length so I can wear it again. Or...maybe I'll buy another one in green???

product_title: DesertWolf Sturdy Vintage Retro Cowhide Leather Canvas Professional Shoulder Messenger Digital Camera Bag
review_headline: Don't Shoot the Messenger.... Bag! Roomy & Looks Great!
review_body:
Photography, like any hobby, has a plethora of accessories; in addition to being expensive, the task of lugging them with you as you travel can be tedious. Whether you are a novice in the field or a professional who is sought out for weddings or model shoots, finding a storage solution that not only protects your investment, but is also roomy and not bulky can be a challenge. Fortunately, I have found that the Winkine® Retro Cowhide Leather Canvas Professional Camera Bag, and here are my impressions of it.

Construction

The title for this product is a bit misleading insofar as the construction of the bag. The bag itself is constructed from heavy-duty canvas, while the front straps which close the flap and a piece on the arm strap are made from leather. The padded insert (the yellow object in the pictures) is made from canvas as well, with some mesh pockets that appear to be nylon. Also, the buckles that you see on the front of the bag that feed through the straps on the pockets are actually decorative; the “slot” is actually sewn onto the strap itself and has a magnet attached. The magnet then connects to another on the front of each pocket and look similar to clothing snaps. That being said the magnets are strong enough to keep the large flap closed, and short of dumping the bag upside down they will remain secured.

In terms of the actual construction, the bag is stitched very tightly with no loose threads or badly-secured pockets and/or zipper. The padded insert is also well-made and customizable; the “lid” for it is connected with a sturdy Velcro® and can be removed completely for quick access. In addition, there are two yellow dividers that connect to the inside of this compartment via Velcro®; you are able to setup the dividers to whichever width needed to accommodate your gear. Lastly, if you wish to remove the yellow compartment completely you may do so, thus converting the main bag into a large side-satchel that is large enough to fit most E-Readers, iPads, Android/Windows Tablets, and smaller laptops.

Use

The Winkine® Retro Cowhide Leather Canvas Professional Camera Bag (WRPCB for short) is very well-made and durable. This is a bag that will be able to withstand considerable abuse, and is roomy enough to store virtually every type of photography lens, flash, transfer cables, cleaning equipment, spare batteries, and so forth. In fact, the only thing that will not fit is a full-size tripod, which is generally not a good idea to store with an expensive camera anyway. Thus, in terms of capacity, the WRPCB is an excellent bag.

The WRPCB is also a great storage bag without the yellow padded storage section. Thus, if you are in need of a quick satchel for work, a weekend trip, or to tote around things for school, the Winkine® bag serves that purpose amiably. There are several small storage pockets: two on the front, one on both sides, and an inner zipper compartment. The back of the bag has a vertical strap with a loop, enabling you to feed a strap through it (think of a large belt loop). All-in-all, this bag has a lot going for it and is constructed with quality in mind. That being said, there are two aspects that prevent me from giving this bag a flawless score. They are minor points, but I do feel had they been included in the design, the WRPCB would be a perfect answer to the storage question for cameras/accessories.

1) There is no handle on the top of the bag, preventing you from carrying it any way except over your shoulder. It would be nice to pick up the bag and be able to hold it without using both hands (and arms!). That being said, since the flap on the front secures via magnets, which do have a good attraction, a heavy bag could result in the flap opening and spilling contents on the ground. While I understand the decision to leave this off, replacing the magnets with actual snaps or proper belt buckles would eliminate the flaw.

2) The flap itself is rather small, which is great when you want quick access and do not want to have to fuss with excess fabric, but also limits the “bulk” of the bag. Think of someone with a large tummy wearing a t-shirt, versus a skinnier person wearing the same size shirt. The flap on this bag is the equivalent of the t-shirt on a skinny person; while it looks great under “ideal” conditions, it does limit the amount of things that you can carry in the bag if you wish for the flap to close properly.

Final Say

This is a high-quality bag that offers ample storage for most camera and their accessories. The Winkine® Retro Cowhide Leather Canvas Professional Camera Bag is well-made, looks great, and offers a customizable storage insert to accommodate a wide variety of photography equipment. That being said, this same insert can be removed to turn this bag into a simple satchel, thus making it a chameleon for all sorts of travel and storage needs. There are some minor flaws in the design, but in the end, they are not enough for me to say that this is a bad product. Thus, whether your purchase is for yourself or a loved one, the Winkine® Retro Cowhide Leather Canvas Professional Camera Bag is a worthwhile investment that will last you a long time with proper care. Final score? 4 stars of 5.

product_title: Meaneor Women Strip Short Sleeve Round Neck Straight Shift Loose Long Tee Dress
review_body:
I was kindly sent this product for honest reviewing purposes.

* About the material:
- Fabric feel: It's described in the product description as a "Cotton Blend", and it does feel quite cotton-like. By this I mean that the fabric feels and looks matte and pretty breathable and it's not silky and spandexy like some cotton blends are, although the fabric does have a bit of stretch to it.
- Fabric thickness: I'd say it's on the thinner side. You can see a black bra worn underneath through the fabric.

* About the fit:
Going by the measurements in the product description, I ordered the Size US M (8-10) (which is labeled on the product as "Large" in Asian sizes.) Whilst this was a good fit, it will probably look best if you have a flat tummy since it isn't very loose over the belly area. For someone like me who has a bit of a sticking-out belly and not much of a waist, it wasn't the most flattering shirt/ dress in the world unfortunately, but if you have the body for it, I think it could look nice. I gave this to a friend who is slimmer than me and it looked far more flattering on her.

* About the length:
On me, the shirt was much longer than it is on the model in the product photo - probably because I'm much shorter than the model being just 5"3. On me, it reached about 3 inches above the knee so could definitely be worn as a dress, albeit a very simple one that could easily also work as an extra long t-shirt.

* About the stitching:
Generally good stitching. There were a few loose threads at one spot but nothing serious that a little trim couldn't fix.

* In summary:
It's a comfortable, casual shirt/ dress; I can imagine it being great for the beach to wear over your bikini. But it probably would look best on people with flat tummies and small, well-defined waists.

product_title: ACEVOG Women 1950s Vintage Retro Capshoulder Party Swing Dress
review_body:
I'm glad I took into account all the negative feedback on this dress before I purchased, because I clearly knew going into it that I would probably be getting a cute dress, but not what I was imagining from the picture. When I lay the dress out on my bed, it looks similar. The chest has that lovely cross-over look, and the color is true, but the differences were apparent. The skirt does not have enough fabric in it to create the folds and motion the picture implies - there's barely room underneath for a petticoat, so achieving the "1950s Vintage Retro" look the dress assures is nigh on impossible. Additionally, I have a rather large chest - 34DD - and I specifically bought an XXL knowing that low-cost dresses manufactured in China are generally not going to cater to my bust size. Even so, the cross-over chest sits ABOVE my actual bust, rather than on it, and the waist fits more to an empire waistline than natural waist. When I first tried it on, I was pulling VERY LIGHTLY at the neckline to try to adjust the bust area, and the seam broke - thankfully, seaming is one of the ONLY things I can manage on my own, sewing wise. On the upside, the fabric is comfortable and has some stretch, plus it's just heavy enough that the skirt wasn't blowing up in the wind outside.

The dress looks cute, could work for a date night or just wearing it to school (modest enough length that I won't be having any mishaps in front of my students), but it doesn't look cute in a way that resembles the picture. As I see it, if I can wear it 4 times, it will be basically worth the price tag - but rather than wearing it alone, as I'd hoped, I now have to be mindful to pair it with sweaters or jackets of some sort, to draw attention away from the fact that the "bust" sits on my upper chest and the "waist" almost at my bust. If you buy it you can probably make it work - but if you're looking for a stand-alone retro style, this may not be the one.

product_title: FIT GEAR Waist Trainer and stomach shaper
review_body:
Waist training has been good so far! I ordered this to help "hold things in" during this time that I can't work out due to a medical issue. I'm on day three and it's been pretty easy and had lots of unexpected benefits.
I ordered an XXL (5'5'', 38 in waist) and it fit fine right out of the bag. This thing is an arm workout to put on at first, and takes some time to find the sweet spot to put it in so that it's not squishing out back fat, or so the boning isn't stabbing you in the boob. It took me about 3 tries to get it just right.
I was able to go 6 hours the first 2 days, and I'm at hour 7 on day 3 and could still go another couple hours. It definitely helps remind you to adjust your posture if you work at a desk job.I also noticed that while I had it on, it really helped quell my PMS cramps!
I'm enjoying the smoothing it gives my shape under clothing, and my arms are sore like I've been working out just from putting this thing on, but that's not a bad thing! I'm excited to try to move to the second row of hooks in a week or so.
Minus a star because I wish the product came with some info, tips/tricks, care info, anything! It was just in a flimsy bag by itself.

review_headline: Adorable Giraffe Printed Backpack Has Tons Of Room For All Back To School Needs!  Pockets & Storage Galore!
review_body:
This Backpack by BTOOP is awesome! It is very sturdy and I noticed right away that all of the stitching is even and tight. It comes in blue and pink, but the blue would be fine for a girl, too because of the adorable little giraffe print all over it. There is a zippered pouch on the back and deep, slender pockets on each side. The straps have a very comfortable and supportive neoprene like material in the lining which keeps it from cutting in on the shoulders. The straps are also adjustable and there is a large loop at the top to hang it in a locker or on a storage rack at home. The zipper pulls are large and easy to find and they and the bottom are made of tan leather.

Once you unzip it and open it up, there is a large, lined pocket to keep a tablet or other electronic device. It opens wide for deep storage of books and there are also two small pockets on the inside to hold plenty of other items. I am quite impressed with the high quality and design of this bookbag. It far exceeded my expectations and is perfect for back to school! I am so glad I was chosen to receive this as a sample, in exchange for my honest, unbiased opinion and feedback. I definitely recommend this backpack and I wish I had one like this when I was in school.

product_title: Lucky Stone-Super Slim Leather Card Wallets - Thin Business Card Wallet - Genuine Cowhide Leather - Front Pocket ID Pass Case Holder
review_body:
I was offered this slim leather card wallet via promotional coupon that made it free to me. The following is my unbiased review based on having tried the product.

This is a well made little wallet. It is small enough to carry in a front pocket. It will hold between 6-10 cards depending on thickness before the wallet feels too bulky or the cards are hard to remove. Credit cards and extra thick or embossed cardstock take up more space vs standard business cards.

This would also work as a vacation wallet. It has the clear pocket for your license or id, and pockets for credit cards or even a small amount of folded cash. Need something for college or high school? Pop in your id and your debit or credit cards or your library card.

It is a useful wallet for those who only carry a few cards at a time. If you are a bulging wallet person, it won't work for you because there will not be space. I only gave it four stars because I prefer the slim wallets that fold over so they can hold more.

The leather seems to be genuine and does not have a foul odor. All seams are well attached, no loose threads. The clear window is well attached and flexible enough that it will not crack easily during long term use.

product_title: V28 Women Full/ankle Length Elastic Pleated Retro Maxi Chiffon Long Skirt
review_body:
Size? there is a clear choice for large or small when ordering, in case anyone missed it. If your waist is bigger than 30", get the larger size, it fit me perfectly.

Slimming? No. But nothing with a gathered waist is going to slim you because the gather adds about an inch overall.

Fabric? It clings, looks like 100% polyester. Not too cheap looking, considering the low price, and if it were thinner, it would tear. For this type of skirt and fabric, this is as good as is possible to get. To get the effect and drape of silk chiffon, spend the $1000+ and buy real silk chiffon.

Well sewn- not flawless, but good job! Not cheaply made.

Value? Terrific. This is a $15 skirt. I bought it to lounge around the house in, and for that, it's perfect. It does cling a bit around the legs, that's the nature of this type of fabric, and unless you get real silk, any skirt will do that.

Does it look expensive? No. Does it look cheap? No.

It is a GREAT value for $15, there's yards of fabric here, and looks like the photos. I got the Navy, it's a very dark, nearly black Navy, and that's exactly what I wanted. Throw a T-shirt over it (untucked), and you are dressed:). I'm happy:).

review_headline: Good quality funny mask, kids love it!

This is a great inexpensive mask that looks better in person. It's funny and somewhat realistic that will throw you back the first time someone sneaks up on you wearing the mask. The latex quality is fine, you might think it's cheap at first, but remember it's only latex. Most such masks at retail stores are made from the exact same material and sell for a much higher price specially around Halloween. The material doesn't have the common latex smell, which I is a huge plus.

The mask size is good, it is big enough to fit an adult and can also fit children say above 8 years of age, even though it will be a little loose but still does its job. It has openings for the eyes and nose and breathes very well. You won't find yourself gasping for air or sweating in this thing. If you're unable to decide on a costume for Halloween, this is a great go-to choice. review_body:
LOL on the 1st customer review - BTW -Flag Etiquette
STANDARDS of RESPECT

The Flag Code, which formalizes and unifies the traditional ways in which we give respect to the flag, also contains specific instructions on how the flag is not to be used. They are:

The flag should never be dipped to any person or thing. It is flown upside down only as a distress signal.
The flag should not be used as a drapery, or for covering a speakers desk, draping a platform, or for any decoration in general. Bunting of blue, white and red stripes is available for these purposes. The blue stripe of the bunting should be on the top.
The flag should never be used for any advertising purpose. It should not be embroidered, printed or otherwise impressed on such articles as cushions, handkerchiefs, napkins, boxes, or anything intended to be discarded after temporary use. Advertising signs should not be attached to the staff or halyard
The flag should not be used as part of a costume or athletic uniform, except that a flag patch may be used on the uniform of military personnel, fireman, policeman and members of patriotic organizations.
The flag should never have placed on it, or attached to it, any mark, insignia, letter, word, number, figure, or drawing of any kind.
The flag should never be used as a receptacle for receiving, holding, carrying, or delivering anything.

When the flag is lowered, no part of it should touch the ground or any other object; it should be received by waiting hands and arms. To store the flag it should be folded neatly and ceremoniously.

The flag should be cleaned and mended when necessary.

When a flag is so worn it is no longer fit to serve as a symbol of our country, it should be destroyed by burning in a dignified manner.

Complicating things is the fact that I have a size 8 head, and "one size fits all" caps look like yarlmulkes with visors on my head. Also, while the cabin of the Corvette is pretty wind protected, I needed something that was styled to stay on the head at interstate speeds. I tried a fitted baseball cap, but it always felt like the wind would get under the bill and lift it off my head.

I saw this Polish made hat, and had to have one. Seeing Marlon Brando in "The Wild One" at age 16 inspired me to go out and buy a British twin motorycycle. This hat fits very well, is made of high quality materials, and if it gets wet from rain exposure, the water shakes off easily and what remains dries without damaging or affecting the cap. The workmanship is also outstanding. Delivery time is surprisingly short.

Be advised, however, that if you want a hat that is exactly the same as that worn by Brando in that movie, this is not it. Brando's cap was camel hair tan in color. But this gray cap with a brown leather visor is very attractive.

review_headline: Fits Perfect! Great for the price!
review_body:
I was tired of purchasing the Jammers from the known brands, and the same time sick of them loosing their color and the snug after a couple of months. Moreover they were very costly. Then I thought lets try the cheaper brands and then I got this "Neleus Men's Rapid Splice Competition Jammer Swimsuit". They are perfect for everything: The Price, the comfort, the fitting and the material too. I thought the material would be itchy but is just perfect like any other jammers or swim pants. BTW, I just use this for my daily swimming, so holding the snug and retaining the color was very important for me. This holds good for both. And yes, if you are using for regular swimming, here's a caring tip: Take a minute or two after you swim and rinse the pant with cold water. ASA you get back home, use some fabric detergent and soak the pant for around 15 minutes and then wash it with cold water, and set it for drying. Don't wash it in washing machine. And if you have an alternate pair, try using this every other day. This way, it drys and at the same time lasts long.

I got many compliments for this jammer, from some of the folks at my Gym's pool. This lets you swim freely, not like the trunks that kinda reduces your speed in the water!

product_title: Jinhuanshow Women's Casual Low-cut Summer Prints Sundresses
review_body:
I love wearing dresses in the summer and when I saw this dress I knew it would be perfect for this summer. I typically wear a small but the smallest size this dress came in was a medium so I went ahead and ordered. The dress is made from a rayon/polyester feeling material. It is very slick and comfortable. This is my favorite type of material to wear in the summer and in a dress. The dress lays perfectly but doesn't cling.

Like I said I typically wear a size small. To give you an idea of size. I am 5' tall and around 110 pounds. The dress fits me a little longer than the product pictures above. It comes just about my knee level. It seems to fit otherwise good. The dress is very low cut in the front and the back so I am wearing a thin tank top underneath. I knew this when I ordered it that I would be wearing a tank underneath. The only other thing that was a little big or it could be like this for everyone is the shoulders do not stay up well on me. I didn't lower my rating of the dress because of this because I felt that if it were a smaller size it might have fit. What I did to fix this was to take the shoulder ties and tie them under my tank straps. That totally fixed this and you cannot tell that they are tied that way. The middle part of the dress is elasticy and is very stretchy so it could be stretched out much bigger.

I love this dress and told my husband this is exactly the kind of dress I have been looking for for summer. It's soft, thin, cool and comfortable and very pretty. I love all the colors and can wear it with different color tanks and flip flops.

product_title: Cats Are Like Libertarians Tshirt
review_headline: Cats will make you a deal.
review_body: I'm not keen on cats.  They crapped all over my barn when we had too many of them. When they began to disappear due to disease, coyotes and other problems inimical to feral cat populations I was thankful. We fed them in order to keep them around and keep the rodent population in check, but they became too large a population (15 or 20 at times) and caused their own problems. We never got a cat on purpose, by the way, they just showed up and liked our barn.  The main point is that even though the cats were not dependent on me, I did offer food and water to keep them around. And although I was not dependent on them, I do enjoy the absence of rodents. We did depend on each other, but no force was involved, and we enjoyed a mutually beneficial arrangement for many years. That sort of voluntary interdependence is what libertarianism is about. It's not taking without giving as this insulting meme, that I first saw on Being Liberal, suggests. (Being Liberal, where opinions are presented as facts, and facts are not allowed.) It's about reaching a mutually beneficial agreement that each party is satisfied with and no party is forced into. In case you haven't noticed, cats aren't really fond of force. Ever try to force a cat to do something?  It doesn't work, and it just pisses off the cat. So, in that respect, yes, cats are like libertarians. Convinced of their own independence?  Hardly. Reserving for themselves the right to negotiate the instances of dependence in their lives?  Absolutely.

review_body:
For starters, it is not made of cotton, tag says nylon.
It also says fishing vest, but no wooly area for hooks.
I bought it for two reasons, photography (hold filters), and air travel - it's a great vest to access your stuff during a flight and increase your carry on capacity without being charged extra!
The plastic package had the size "large"on it, though the garment tag says "XL" - Large is accurate, it is not loose. Pockets are oversized, not the garment.
It is well made, has side snaps to make if more fitted, 2 side open pockets (which you can't really see in the photo), other pockets have Velcro closures.
Upper chest pockets are big but too deep, enough to drop a tablet in, but have to fish it out. Only one interior pocket, which is zippered - that pocket has plenty of room there for a passport.
Front hand pockets are actually 3 pockets, 2 top ones and a side pocket below.
Has the brand "Mica" embroidered, as well as the style name on the back "Strangemica"; it is the same color as the material so it doesn't stand out. Vented back as well.
If this is what you're looking for, are OK that it is not cotton (which for me was a good thing), I would recommend it - for the price it is a great value.

product_title: Vertical Sport Men's Active Basic Jogger Athletic Fit Fleece Sweat Pants
review_headline: I haven't yet tried them on an extended hike, but so far these pants have performed fairly well for exercise and short hikes
review_body:
This pair of men's jogging JG2 sweatpants is sold by Vertical Sport and fulfilled by Amazon. (I could not find a website for Vertical Sport.) I received them from Amazon as part of a multi-item shipment. They were packed in a clear plastic bag. The pants are designed with two side pockets and a single open back pocket (i.e., no closure flap). They were made in China out of 100% polyester with the exception of the two side pockets (not the back pocket) which are 96% polyester and 4% spandex to allow stretching. Even though the material is advertised as fleece, it is actually "polar fleece", in which synthetic polyester fibers are woven into a soft nap. There is no organic material or wool in the pants. The material has a somewhat slick, soft feel to it. The 2 1/2" wide elastic waistband can be cinched with a front tying drawstring and the ankle cuffs are 2" wide elastic bands. It has this odd fake men's fly flap sewn into the front of the crotch...kinda strange...anyway, there is no zipper or opening, just a flap design. The pants seem to be sized about right.

On almost all outdoors forums the consensus seems to be that cotton and denim are bad choices for hiking and camping ("cotton is rotten") because they take time to dry out while polyester is good because it drys quickly if you get wet (e.g., you get rained on or have to wade a stream, etc.). I do not necessarily agree with this since I have hiked and camped quite a bit wearing denim jeans and cotton t-shirts with no problems. In my experience, 100% polyester material usually has breathability and wicking problems in which limited moisture wicking traps perspiration between my skin and the material. It can feel very uncomfortable over a long hike or extended work on a hot day. Surprisingly, I found the JG2's to be fairly tolerable in that respect. Even though they don't have the comfort level of cotton, the pants seem to have a limited level of breathability. I really liked the design of the elastic ankle cuffs that your can tuck into your hiking boots or that keep your pants clear of your shoes when jogging. (Most hiking pants have open cuffs that go over the tops of your boots.) Although I haven't yet had the opportunity to try them on an extended hike, so far these pants have performed fairly well for exercise and short hikes. As for the material, you may want to also try a cotton/polyester blend that supports some kind of wicking technology. I have found blended material to be more comfortable than 100% polyester clothing.

product_title: Leward Mens Casual Slim Fit Cotton Solid Multi-Pocket Cargo Camouflage Shorts
review_headline: Good build quality; nice look and fit (provided you up-size)
review_body:
I’m very pleased with these shorts. The build quality is quite good considering the price. There were a few loose/dangling thread ends (mostly on the inside pocket flaps and at the leg ends) that needed to be cut, but overall, the stitching was tight and even.

The fasteners on the leg and back pockets are snaps, and are of good quality. The waist fastener is a post and loop rather than a snap. The post is of decent quality (a bit lightweight, but OK). However, the loop (the hole the post goes into) is cut a bit small. It’s a little tough to unfasten at first, but after it breaks in it gets better.

The waist is the only area where the build quality could be better. It’s rather thin, which is good for comfort, but also makes it a bit prone to rolling a little. It could have used some facing or thicker material to give it more strength and rigidity.

The fabric is soft and, according to the product listing, is 100% cotton. It feels like cotton, but there’s no product tag that lists the fabric composition.

The fit is good provided that you order a size LARGER than you need. For example, I normally take a 34 waist. I got this as a 36 and the fit is fine. Very comfortable at the waist, and fits well in the seat without being baggy or too tight.

The legs are cut so that they are right at the knee. The overall look is very casual, so the cut is appropriate. I have it in gray, and I really like the color -- it's a blue-gray that goes with pretty much everything.

For the price, these are a solid value. Look nice and casual, fit well, and are decently made. The few build quality misses brings my rating to 4.5 stars, but I'll round up since I like the casual look.
[Sample provided for review]

product_title: RFID SAFE Alpine Swiss Men's Leather Wallet Hybrid Bifold with Flipout ID
review_headline: Nice feel, good quality. Missing a feature or two, but I'm hoping I'm protected.
review_body:
My first day of owning this wallet, and my impressions so far:

PROS- soft, nice leather. Folds pretty flat if you don't have too much in it.

The main reason I bought this is because I'm 99% sure that someone filched my credit card info by walking up to me with one of those scanners while I was at a St. Louis Cardinals baseball game. I live 3.5 hours away in IN. And 1 or 2 days after the baseball game, someone used my credit card to try to make 2 purchases at a Home Depot in a suburb of St. Louis. No, I was never there. The first charge went through at Home Depot (over $200) and the second charge attempt at the same store for over $500 was declined. The credit card company didn't make me pay, of course. But there was a big hassle in contacting all the companies that I have things auto-charged to. So, I'm hoping this works for the reason I got it: RFID protection.

CONS: I am hoping the leather loosens up a bit. But the credit card slots on one side of the wallet are smaller than the slots on the other side of the wallet. A card that slips in smoothly but snugly on one side has to be forced into the slot on the other side.
And I should've looked more carefully before purchasing this wallet to see if there are any others that have a zippered slot where the money goes, or at least a divider of some sort. This one does not, and I already miss not having that. I did make this wallet purchase in a hurry because after the credit card hacking incident, I had wrapped my cards in aluminum foil, a real hassle.

product_title: Demarkt Men's Underwear Breathable Briefs G-string Thong Grey
review_body: My waist is 32-33, and the mediums fit me just fine. (11/19/16 Update: they changed their size chart - I would order 'Large' now.) I searched hi and lo for replacements for my King Style jocks. These Demarkt jock straps (they are NOT thongs) are super comfy, stretchy, minimalist yet solid, and durable. These jocks sport well-sculpted pouches, nothing too exotic. I've machine-washed my first pairs dozens of times with no physical degradation except a slight color fade. I order a pair or two every month or so, and will keep doing so until I have a whole drawer full of them. These are mesh, which means that in certain weather conditions (hot humid days do it for me), depending on how your skin responds to temperature and humidity, tiny nodules of your skin will get stuck in the pores of the mesh. I've worn many styles over the years -- and all mesh briefs are subject to this; when it's hot and humid, I have to peel the fabric away from my skin to regain total comfort maybe once or twice a day. In all other weather, it doesn't happen at all. 'Great product' I'm happy to report.

review_headline: My new favorite pair of pants!
review_body:
[[ASIN:B00YIX1K4K Dockers Men's Alpha Khaki Slim Tapered Flat Front Pant, New British Khaki/Stretch, 34x32]]

I am always on the lookout for a good pair of khaki pants because I wear them a lot for work. But, I am also somewhat style conscience. I really don't like wearing pleated pants anymore. review_body: I've been looking forward to getting this outfit for quite some time. Fits as expected. Images in non-model photos are true to the colors of it. The top isn't perfect, but the side-boob I get from it looks good and it wears in a way that I will not be flashing anyone. I can't wear a bra with it, not even one of those front-only bras as it would show on the side. It will need to be washed first to get the square packing wrinkles out of it before public wear. Over all, the outfit is flattering, it's fun, and believe it or not, I think it makes my back fat look sexy! I look forward to wearing it this summer.

review_body:
*UPDATE* I no longer recommend the buckles that go with these belts. If the buckle has a comma shaped lever, it will probably break while you're wearing the belt and you will be trapped! Seriously, stick with SlideBelt. It's the best design; you simply lift the buckle cover and it releases the belt.

Having started with SlideBelt, I was looking to replace my black belt minus the buckle. The price for a leather strap was $25-30, so I looked at some recommendations and saw these EazyBelt offerings. I ordered this and a saddle brown belt, because I figured for $19 I couldn't not try these out when they include a buckle. The leather is bit shinier than I'd like, but seems very decent for the price and the buckle works quite differently than the SlideBelt. A little lever must be actuated on the bottom edge of the buckle in order to release the belt. In some cases you must push in toward the buckle with the belt ot make this work, but it's just a matter of getting used to it.

The buckle is quite handsome, and quite heavy. But, value wise, I don't think you can beat this.

review_body: Decided last minute to enter my DD in a local pageant - her 1st so I didn't want to spend mounds of $$ on it.  I couldn't decide between dresses so I bought two, this being one of them.  The pageant was in about 3 weeks after I bought the dress so I had to pay for rush shipping & hope at least one of them got delivered on time, especially since being shipped International! Before placing the order I contacted the seller to just ask if they thought it could arrive on time (they guaranteed it would). A few minutes later I bought the dress & asked again (not realizing they'd already responded to the 1st message - again they assured me it'd come in time).  A week before the pageant it wasn't here so I contacted again & they updated the shipping/tracking on Amazon & it arrived to me just a few days later. Before committing to buy I measured my (tall & skinny 2.5 y/o DD) & her measurements matched their advertised size 2 in the size chart perfectly so that's what I bought & it fit like a glove! The craftsmanship was much better than I expected for a "cheap" dress (compared to the $300-$800 one's I first started checking on).  Up close you can tell the crystals on it are the cheap plastic kind but I mean you REALLY have to be looking for it.  The stitching was phenomenal.  The choker necklace thing was pointless, I can't imagine putting it on her (quality was good just looked silly) but I'm glad it came with it because I can try incorporating it into a matching bow or cabbaging sequins & gems off it in the event of a missing stone on pageant day (this Saturday).  Overall I would def. recommend this dress.  If you have concerns over it contact the sellers, they are great at getting back with you!

review_headline: SHIPS IN PERSON SIGNATURE REQUIRED UNLESS YOU TELL THEM TO SHIP ANOTHER WAY!
review_body: First - I had to drive to the post office to pick up the package because the shipper sends registered, in person signature required. I am work when my mail is delivered, so I emailed the seller and they responded promptly, suggesting future purchases include request for "no signature required."  Obviously, they couldn't do anything about the package that was already shipped.  The skirts are beautiful, but they don't exactly look like the pictures, they are much straighter than shown.  I ordered 2 - the brown & grey colors.  The quality is about what I expected shipping from Thailand.  They are a little overpriced for the quality, but they are unique and I decided to take a chance.  I would definitely hand wash or cold water, gentle machine cycle only. Any other way and I would expect them to fall apart.  The sizing is the problem.  The description says to 36" waist.  Not a chance. And if you are curvy like I am, don't buy these.  I wear 34" waist in pants and these are way, way too tight over the hips.  There is no way this skirt will fit a size 14. As I mentioned, the skirts are straighter from the waist than shown in the pictures.  The waist isn't too small, but the straight line makes them too tight through my hips.  If you have a straight shape from the waist down and your waist isn't over about 31-32", they will look great.  Over my curves, no way.  I'd need to lose a minimum of 6" from the waist down for these to fit & flow correctly.  (I am already trying to do just that, so I will hang on to the skirts for a while yet, for a little extra incentive)  Overall, they are OK.  A little overpriced, but they are a unique look - they are light and flowy.  Perfect for summer.  Quality no better & no worse than anything shipping from Thailand.  Don't have your expectations too high.  Don't buy if you are curvy, they won't hang or flow correctly.  Regardless of the product description, don't buy if your waist is over 32".  These skirts wouldbe beautiful on the right body shape. Just not on mine.

review_body:
Aesthetic: First, I have to say the colors are extremely, beautifully vivid on this robe! The hues are bright, very pretty, and work in harmony with each other. Printed is a peacock and blooming flowers. When I ordered I was quite nervous that it would look different but it is actually more beautiful in person. The material is very shiny. I chose "Acid Blue" color.

Feel: It was so hard not to immediately wear this when I first opened the bag. The material is SUPER silky. I've always used a plush (winter) robe but this is something else. I wanted something lightweight for summer use and this definitely is that + more. It is soft and very comfortable. It feels great on!

Quality: The robe itself is made well. There are two, sturdy fabric loops on the sides for the tie to go through. I did not find any loose threads on my robe and the sewing looks good. No pockets (not that I need one, but in case you were curious).

Sizing: I'm normally a small but chose size M as it tends to be on the small size. This decision was based on their size chart and other customer comments. I do believe that this could work for someone who wears medium but I would size up just to be on the safe side!

It's definitely less expensive than similar quality and style robes that I have seen at other shops near me. Overall I love it!

product_title: Women's Spaghetti Strap Top with Contrast Binding
review_headline: I love this top but the sizing chart is WAY off...
review_body:
I am really in love with this top and I ordered it in a large (normally, that is what I am, in US sizes: 12/14), thinking that the Amazon size chart was correct as displayed for this item. However, there is no way, even as an XL that this top will fit me, let alone zip. I gave it 4 stars because I felt that the true measurements could have been clearer and I was disappointed to find out that it was way off. I feel bad in returning it, because I love it, but as no one in my household is this size, there is no point in keeping it. My deepest apologies to the seller.

I will tell you, though, that the fabric feels very strong, yet light weight (like a heavy satin or silk--yet it's polyester) and well-chosen for this application. The shape and cut is nice and the pink contrast is really pretty. The seams are straight, neat and the edges are well-finished. The zipper is heavy-duty and ready for battle...but there was no way it was going to win on me. Haha.

It appears that it will last a long time if the care instructions are followed: Machine wash Cold, gentle cycle, No Bleach, Lay Flat to Dry, Cool Iron on the reverse if needed.

I will update this review if needed after my return has been taken care of.

*This item was purchased at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review. Any opinions are my own from personal experience*

product_title: Slim Leather Wallet for Men - Bifold Zippered Wallet with 8 Card Slots,Durable wallet with 2 bill holders, Travel Wallet 2 Quick Access ID Windows, Minimalist Leather Wallet
review_headline: Very Nice Wallet, With Special Zippered Bills Section
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:eba6fa51ef9ed789459441958b4a183]] The DANCL® Men's Leather Flipout ID bi-fold wallet is a standard size wallet that should provide many years of service.
The leather is soft and appears to be high quality. The name is embossed on the front and that adds a nice touch to the appearance. The name is also embossed on the inside on the right hand credit card slot. This is a nice touch.

There are three credit card slots on each side of the wallet. You could double up if you have an excess number of cards but that tends to make the wallet bulky. There are two window slots on the \\"flip-out\\" section. The \\"flip-out\\" part is permanently attached to the wallet. You will find some men who prefer a detachable flip-out section while others like the safety provided by a permanently attached flip-out section. The window slots are for your driver's license and any other identification what you might need to show often - such as health insurance card, employer ID, etc.

The bill section has a divider so you can sort the folding money by value. The neatest feature of this wallet is the zippered compartment at the rear of the bills section. If you carry large bills, you will want to store your large bills in the zippered compartment. I like to carry a cash reserve so I never run out of money. I keep my cash reserve in the zippered section and I know if I have to \\"borrow\\" from my cash reserve, it is time to replenish it.

The wallet is very nice. The materials appear to be good quality. If you are considering this as a gift, just be aware that it does not come in a box. If you are buying the wallet for yourself, the lack of a box should not matter.

I was provided a sample for testing/review purposes.

product_title: Flare Skirt, Knee Length Elegant Quilted Pull-on Style for Business or Casual
review_body:
I received this flare skirt and I am used to buying clothes online that run small. I think that this one is closer to the sizes that are available in stores. So do not buy up thinking that it will be too small. Buy your actual size. I like that this skirt is so versatile. I can be dressed up or down. It can be worn to work, church or out on the town. I have worn it with flats and with sandals; both shoe options looked great. The skirt is made from a quilted wrinkle resistant fabric. It really is wrinkle resistant. I through this skirt into a suitcase and flew half way across the country. Then, I rummaged through my luggage for at least a week before I pulled the skirt our to wear. Much to my surprise and pleasure, the skirt was in pristine condition.

I got the skirt in charcoal because it is a versatile color. Much of my wardrobe looks like Rainbow Bright was sick in my closet. I can put a bright colored top on, like a teal sleeveless silk shirt or any pastel or any black or white and it looks just right with this skirt. I am pleased that the skirt does not have a zipper. It is a pull on skirt. Not only are skirts without zippers more comfortable to wear they also come worry-free for washing. Many people have little tiny holes in their shirts right around the belly button, those are typically caused from zippers snagging them in the washer and dryer. I don't have to stress about separating this and washing it with jeans. I can help balance out the lighter shirt loads.

I also really like that this product is made in the USA.

review_body:
My daughter loves fun and funky stuff, including clothing, so when she saw these “Space Cats Love Cheeseburgers” leggings, she insisted she wanted them!

They were out of the smallest size, so I ordered a medium (my size), and it fits me well. I am about 5’7″ and around 130 lbs, and I usually wear about a size 6-8 for clothing. I used the size chart on Amazon.com and although I am hesitant about ordering clothing online, the leggings fit just right.

My 8 year old really wants these leggings, and surprisingly, they fit her, although not tight like a legging. They are a little loose and long, but wearable. (See my photo - she is tall for her age). So in the fall, she will be wearing them to school.

The graphics on these leggings are pretty cool. I like that the pattern isn’t just repeating a single image, and there are a variety of different cat images throughout the leggings.

These leggings are 95% Polyester and 5% Spandex. They are very comfortable, and since I don’t see myself wearing these on any regular occasion, I think they would make a fun set of leggings for the gym. However, I’m pretty sure my daughter has claimed these!

I received these leggings in exchange for my honest review. This product is lots of fun!

If you look closely though, the green-looking bit is actually closer to grey colored and this is clearer in real life. Other than that, the colors are as seen in the photo, vibrant and fiery, and the pattern is cute and summery with the big flower design.    * Overall: A great quality summery beach dress that's also comfortable and I liked the custom-fitting bust. review_body:
I am a big advocate of postpartum recovery shapers like this support belt. I am only 5'3" and my torso is very short. When pregnant, my ribs expand so much they hurt. I have only given birth through C-section and recovery takes longer. I have used shapers like this and I am SO pleased to see how they have become more affordable and easy to find. I cannot over emphasize how good this is for you especially if you have a short torso like me. You can easily avoid back pain because the belt is well supported on the back - it almost looks like a Band-Aid.

The back is 9 inches in length which covers a good part of my back up to where my bra sits. It is well reinforced but not super stiff. The fabric breathes which is nice. Start with a few hours a day or as long as you can handle it - it doesn't hurt C-section incisions. Be sure to check the measurements on the description. By rule of thumb, go approximately with the size you were before pregnancy. If you are in between sizes, chose the one larger, it will be more comfortable to start with.

product_title: Buttons & Pleats Advanced Type Shirt Stays Durable with Non-slip Locking Clamps
review_body:
I don't know about anyone else but for some reason whenever my shirt gets all pulled out and wrinkly I get so damn self conscious thinking the whole room's eyes are are on me even though logically I know nobody really cares. I would always excuse myself to the bathroom every hour or two to readjust my dress shirt to make sure it was nice and tucked in. Nothing ruins my confidence more than looking sloppy. Eventually I decided to google some methods on how to keep my shirt nicely tucked in throughout a long day and the most common answer I found was to use a shirt stay. I then discovered the Buttons and Pleats Shirt Stays and after using them for a few days I have to say I am absolutely in love with these things! Ever after a long day of constant movement my shirt stayed nice and tucked in and I didn't have excuse myself to the bathroom to readjust my shirt once! This was a huge confidence booster and time saver for me. I purchased the Y strap option and it worked amazing, I just attach one hook from each leg to the back of my dress shirt and the other to the sides of my dress s*** and make sure there is a firm grip. I can't believe I didn't use a shirt stay sooner but now that I have discovered them, I don't think I'll ever put on a dress shirt (unless it's a casual one) without them again.
